lfsStrategy.fallbackMechanism: GraphQL diskUsage delta combined with repository .gitattributes LFS indicator detection
lfsStrategy.nonDestructiveConstraint: Discovery must operate read-only without cloning repository git objects or calling destructive git commands
lfsStrategy.contractsAlignment: Maps to Entity[kind = 'lfs'] with storage (BytesMetric availability: 'observed' | 'unknown' with reason), objectCount, and indicator ('detected' | 'not_detected' | 'unknown')
lfsStrategy.reasoning: GitHub does not provide a single endpoint for per-repository Git LFS object sizes without querying the Git LFS batch protocol or cloning. Non-destructive assessment relies on organization-level shared storage billing and repository-level LFS tracking indicators, honestly reporting availability as unknown when precise byte counts cannot be observed without repo pack inspection.

copilotDomain.assessmentScope: Auditing allocated Copilot seats, active editor adoption, and organization-level policy assignments during cloud migration.

emuIdentityDomain.pseudonymizationEnforcement: All user logins and external identity names returned must be pseudonymized via HMAC-SHA256 (usr_<hash>) before writing discovery entities.
emuIdentityDomain.teamSyncMapping: Maps external IdP groups to GitHub teams without storing corporate employee directory personal data.
emuIdentityDomain.piiProtection: Prohibits retention or display of corporate email addresses, real names, or employee IDs.
